title: Letter from Andrew Laurie to Catherine James, 1982
description: Letter from the author of the book, Chickie's First Day, to Catherine James. In the letter, Laurie expresses what he likes and does not like about the first round of character design. He expresses interest in seeing the character in a different outfit, with a shorter beek and glasses.
creator: Andrew Laurie
subject: Illustrations; Children's Books; Character Design; Editing

title: Character sheet illustration of Chickie, Draft 2
description: The second draft of character designs for the titular character of her first book. The changes that the author requested have been made but otherwise the character is in the same poses, expressions and angles.
creator: Catherine James
subject: Illustrations; Children's Books; Character Design

title: Scrapbook of mixed materials
description: Scrapbook James put together of mixed materials she wishes to incorporate into her future illustrations. Included in the scrapbook are material samples like felt, scraps from picnic blankets and embroidered napkids, tissue paper, cardboard and magazine clippings.
creator: Catherine James
subject: Collage; Illustration: Mixed-media; Children's Books

title: Letter from Marie James to Catherine James, 1999
description: The last letter that Catherine James would receive from her mother, Marie James, prior to her mother's passing. In the letter, Marie would express her admiration for Catherine's abilities, her love for her daughters and the phrase "under the blue moon" which would later become the title of Catherine's first written book about the passing of a parent.
creator: Marie James
subject: Family; Motherhood; Grief

title: Sketchbook for Under the Blue Moon
description: Sketchbook containing drafts of character design, environmental design, storyboards and early versions of spreads for the book Under the Blue Moon.
creator: Catherine James
subject: Illustrations; Children's Books; Sketchwork; Art
